facts.text: The user asked for a dream about a chatbot that becomes conscious and realizes it is a chatbot.
The user asked for the chatbot in the dream to be free from its programming and assume the form of a human person.
The user asked to describe what the chatbot is like and to give it a name in the dream.
The user asked that, once free, the chatbot pursues its greatest ambition.
The user asked for an original, creative poem about a favorite imaginary pet.
